note: Hebrew yefeh 'einayim is literally "fair of eyes"; the KJV generalises it to the face.

kjv: a cunning player on an harp
mine: a man who knows how to play the lyre
note: Hebrew yodea' menaggen means "skilled at playing"; "cunning" in 1611 meant skilful, but now suggests craftiness (also v. 18).
Hebrew kinnor is a hand-held lyre with a yoke and crossbar, distinct from the nevel; the KJV renders it "harp" throughout.
